decisions.reason: The charting bundle is a cheap plugin on the established map.apps platform and had an active release cadence, so keeping the option open costs little, although its absence from the website in 2020–2021 raises doubts about its demand.
The software platform is the firm's flagship and strategic base, on which the other bundles depend, so it is a core commitment rather than a marginal option to abandon.
Mobile field data capture fits the firm's enterprise GIS offer and addresses growing demand for mobile workflows, so its value is still plausible despite the lack of recent visibility.

The search extension overlaps with the hierarchical search plugin already withdrawn, and with no visible presence since 2018 its value appears unlikely to materialize, so the resources are better redirected to the platform and new development.
